profile.summary: mgol is a mid-level JavaScript reviewer with deep expertise in jQuery's core functionality, including DOM manipulation, CSS APIs, and module system migrations (AMD to ES6). Their reviews demonstrate strong proficiency in jQuery's testing ecosystem (QUnit) and build tooling (Grunt.js/ESLint), with particular attention to backward compatibility and behavior changes. While their knowledge is heavily focused on legacy frontend patterns and jQuery internals, they show familiarity with modern ES6+ module systems and basic build optimization practices. There is no evidence of modern frontend frameworks (React/Vue/Angular), TypeScript, or backend JavaScript experience in their contributions.
